{"claims": [
  {
    "confidence":  "high",
    "failing_input": "A cleared bar course whose plan is {jumpXs: [..., 10], hands: true, hangTicks: [120], releaseAfter: 60, bouncePress: 8}, called with seed 1 and sigmaMs = 0.",
    "file": "src/sim/ideal.ts",
    "line": 566,
    "summary": "`playImperfect` discards every plan field except `jumpXs`, `releaseAfter`, and `bouncePress`, so even zero-noise runs do not reproduce the supplied plan.",
    "why": "The constructed `noisy` plan loses fields such as `hands`, `hangTicks`, `vaultXs`, `climbXs`, `aim`, and `fireXs`; with sigma 0 it should be behaviorally identical to the original, but on the bar course the runner never holds the bar and can incorrectly return null."
  },
  {
    "confidence":  "high",
    "failing_input": "A perfect first attempt that clears at runner.tick = 1200, i.e. 10.0 s at 120 Hz, with sigmaMs = 0.",
    "file": "src/sim/ideal.ts",
    "line": 572,
    "summary": "`playImperfect` adds the one-second restart penalty before checking whether that attempt cleared.",
    "why": "It returns 11.0 s for a first-attempt clear at 10.0 s, although no restart occurs after the successful attempt; by the stated definition it should return 10.0 s."
  },
  {
    "confidence":  "high",
    "failing_input": "For an edge at 10 m, candidate scores where press x = 7.00 clears, x = 7.02 reaches only 9 m, and x = 7.04 clears.",
    "file": "src/sim/ideal.ts",
    "line": 361,
    "summary": "The edge search reports the minimum-to-maximum span of all best-scoring presses instead of the longest consecutive group of good presses.",
    "why": "`good` contains 7.00 and 7.04, so the reported window is lo = 7.00, hi = 7.04 even though the intervening tested press 7.02 fails; this contradicts the adjacent comment and overstates the clearing window."
  },
  {
    "confidence":  "medium",
    "failing_input": "A trampoline course whose relevant take-off edge is at x = 50 m and whose clearing bounce press is 25 ticks rather than the default 8 ticks.",
    "file": "src/sim/ideal.ts",
    "line": 374,
    "summary": "Bounce-press tuning is hard-coded to run only for edges strictly between 117 m and 119 m.",
    "why": "For the edge at 50 m, every search trial keeps `bouncePress = 8` and `tuneTicksGen` is never called, so the search can report a clearable trampoline course as not cleared and cannot find its ideal press."
  },
  {
    "confidence":  "medium",
    "failing_input": "A runner that remains grounded in mode `run` with |vx| < 0.01 for exactly 180 consecutive ticks.",
    "file": "src/sim/ideal.ts",
    "line": 160,
    "summary": "The stationary-run cutoff triggers after 181 ticks instead of the stated 1.5 s, which is 180 ticks at 120 Hz.",
    "why": "`still` becomes 180 after 1.5 s but the condition is `still > 180`, so `playPlan` simulates one extra tick before breaking."
  },
  {
    "confidence":  "low",
    "failing_input": "A `run`-mode world with outcome `running`, runner.grounded = false, positioned above a platform so the simulated fall lands within 240 ticks.",
    "file": "src/sim/predict.ts",
    "line": 32,
    "summary": "`predictJump` never returns the declared `not-grounded` result for an airborne runner.",
    "why": "It sets `startGrounded = false`, consequently never presses jump, but still returns `result: 'lands'` as though the requested jump had been evaluated."
  }
]}
